K_problems.why: Budget, decision owner and data owner each need an internal memo or a colleague's confirmation. I can't finish in one sitting, so I lose everything when I leave to ask.

K_problems.problem: Session expires after 10 minutes of inactivity
K_problems.why: I have to wait for colleagues and I switch between desktop and tablet. Ten minutes plus no draft-saving means I lose my work again and again.

K_problems.problem: Trade licence no., Company legal name and ISIC code are mandatory
K_problems.why: I am a government department, not a company. There is no trade licence, so I either can't submit at all or I have to put false data on an official form.
I'm not authorised to state the department's risk appetite. Methodology is what the consultant should propose. They're nonsense questions in a government context.

K_problems.problem: Jargon: 'EngagementSpec', 'EvidenceItems', 'M02 critical gaps', 'provenance class: observed', sales_tx/cust_master/mkt_spend_ts
K_problems.why: Internal system language, and it's written for sales and marketing, not tourism. I can't translate it for my director or justify it to IT.
I think in Arabic, and leadership needs Arabic. An English-only screen with technical terms makes me misread and slows me down.

K_problems.problem: Upload by drag-and-drop only, no button
K_problems.why: On the tablet, drag-and-drop barely works. A screen-reader user can't use it at all.

K_problems.problem: Upload straight to the cloud with no word on where the data is stored or how it is protected
K_problems.why: I'm not allowed to upload to unapproved cloud without IT approval. Without a hosting and security statement I can't submit the IT request in the first place, so I stop here.

K_problems.problem: No path for 'the data is held by another department' or 'it needs approval'
K_problems.why: Most of the data is with statistics, the municipality and immigration. There's no invite or delegation option and no 'pending approval' state, so the gaps stay red with no way forward.

K_problems.problem: Red and green dots with no text
K_problems.why: Colour alone doesn't tell me what's required. Nothing says what is mandatory or what is optional.

K_problems.problem: 'Error 422: schema mismatch' toast that disappears in 3 seconds
K_problems.why: Incomprehensible and gone before I can read or translate it. No explanation and no example of a correct file.

K_problems.problem: Status screen: a spinner and nothing else
K_problems.why: No expected date, no stage, nothing from my side. Leadership asks me 'when?' and I have no answer.

K_problems.problem: No mention of a formal deliverable (Arabic PDF/Word)
K_problems.why: My whole goal is an official report. I don't know if I'll get a document I can submit.

K_problems.problem: No mention of the consultant's review or who approves
K_problems.why: I need assurance that a human reviewed the content before it goes to leadership.

walkthrough: Day 0, ~10 min: I open the chat on the desktop and write the problem in Arabic (justifying an allocation for tourism infrastructure). If replies come in Arabic, good. If a translated term looks odd (e.g. 'conversion'), I lose confidence.
Day 0, ~15 min: questions come one at a time. Easy, but with no estimate of how many are left I can't plan my time. The summary card is clear and I press [That's right].

Day 0, ~10 min: data requests arrive as separate messages: visitor numbers (from the statistics authority), hotel occupancy (another department), the previous budget. There's no 'someone else has this' button, only [Upload] or [I don't have this]. I press 'I don't have this' and I'm stuck. Stuck point 1.

Day 1-3: I send an IT approval request for the platform. I need a security and hosting document to attach, and the chat doesn't provide one, so I have to ask in the chat and wait for a reply. Stuck point 2.

Day 14-30: approval and data arrive by email from the other departments. I come back to the chat and scroll a long thread to find which message was asking for what. Nothing tells me what's still missing. Stuck point 3. ~20 min.

Day 35: the report arrives as a long chat message plus [Download PDF]. I don't know if the PDF is in Arabic, or if it has an official structure with an executive summary, methodology and appendices. There's no Word file to edit before submitting through the official channels. Stuck point 4.
Possible abandonment: on day 14 if IT doesn't approve a platform that 'looks like a chat', or if the PDF comes out in English only.
A.quote: المحادثة مريحة، لكن لا أستطيع أن أقدّم لمعالي الوكيل سلسلة رسائل. أريد وثيقة رسمية بالعربية، وأريد أن أعرف ماذا بقي عليّ دون أن أقرأ الحوار كله من أوله.

walkthrough: Day 0, ~10 min: I describe the problem in Arabic in one text box, then answer 4 short questions. It saves automatically, so if I'm interrupted for a meeting I lose nothing.
Day 0, ~5 min: the 'Your next step' card says: 'Confirm we understood your problem (2 min)'. I edit one line on the 'other possible causes' list and confirm.

Day 0, ~15 min: the data checklist. Each item has a 'why we need it' and is labelled Must have or Helpful. On 'visitor numbers' I press [Someone else has this → invite them] and send an invite to my colleague at the statistics authority. This is exactly what I need.

Day 0: I need IT approval before uploading the internal budget. The page doesn't show a security and hosting document I can attach to the request, and there's no 'awaiting IT approval' status. I write to support. Stuck point 1.
Day 3: my colleague in the other department receives the invite. Their IT may block an external link. Will they upload directly or send it to me? Unclear. Stuck point 2.

Day 3-25: whenever I come back (sometimes from the tablet) I see the progress tracker and the next step at a glance, ~3 min per visit. A file upload fails, and the explanation plus the example file solve it in ~10 min.

Day 30: report: the answer in one paragraph, steps, 'How sure are we?' per finding, risks. [Arabic version] [PDF/Word]. I need to check the Arabic translation is official-quality and that the Word file has a formal structure (cover page, methodology, references) for the leadership template. If it's just a copy of the web page, I'll spend a day reformatting. Stuck point 3 (possible).
WhatsApp notifications: I may not be allowed to use them for official work, so I'd choose email only.
Possible abandonment: only if IT refuses the platform for lack of a hosting and security statement.
B.quote: هذا أقرب ما رأيت لطريقة عملنا: أعرف خطوتي التالية، وأستطيع دعوة زميلي في الجهة الأخرى، ودرجة الثقة لكل نتيجة تحميني أمام القيادة. فقط أعطوني ورقة أمن معلومات أرسلها لتقنية المعلومات، ونسخة Word عربية بقالب رسمي.

walkthrough: Day 0, ~25 min: a 5-step wizard. Company profile (6 fields): if it asks for a trade licence it doesn't fit a government entity. Stuck point 1. The 'Policy' category is a good sign. Draft-saving helps me pause to confirm the budget with finance.
Day 0, ~10 min: Goals and KPIs with suggestions. Useful if they include tourism indicators (occupancy, visitor spending). Constraints and budget, then submit.

Day 1, ~10 min: data page as a table with downloadable templates. Templates help me send a clear request to the other departments by official letter. But there's no invite button for them, so I collect the data myself and upload it, which needs IT approval first. Stuck point 2.

Day 1-30: dashboard with 40% completeness and 0% progress. I don't know exactly what's required of me, or whether the delay is on my side or theirs. Stuck point 3. Is RTL handled properly in the tables and charts?

Day 35: a formal report with executive summary, methodology, findings, confidence appendix and recommendations, as PDF/Word. Exactly the format leadership expects, as long as an Arabic version exists.
Possible abandonment: during the waiting period, because the percentages don't tell me what to do.
C.quote: التقرير النهائي بالشكل الذي تعرفه القيادة، والمعالج مألوف لنا من الأنظمة الحكومية. لكن لوحة النِّسَب لا تقول لي ماذا أفعل، ولا أستطيع إشراك الجهات الأخرى مباشرة.

interrogation.a: If the platform requires uploading data to an unknown cloud with no security and hosting statement I can attach to the IT request. Or if the final report arrives in English only. Either one ends the matter for me, because I can't proceed or can't submit.
interrogation.b: An official Arabic report (Word plus PDF) with a cover page, an executive summary for leadership, a clear methodology, the source of every number (which department and which year), the confidence level of each finding and the reason for it, the assumptions and their sensitivity (what happens to the recommendation if visitor numbers are 10% lower), and the name of the consultant who reviewed and approved it. I need to be able to defend every number in front of the undersecretary and the finance committee.
interrogation.c: In B: (1) a 'Security & Data Residency' package: an Arabic PDF I can download and send to IT, covering where the data is stored (inside the country?), encryption, and deletion; (2) a 'Pending internal approval' status for each data item, with the expected date tracked automatically; (3) a Word export on an official government template with C's structure (executive summary, methodology, appendices), not a copy of the web page; (4) full RTL and Arabic as the base language, not a translation; (5) a choice of email only instead of WhatsApp; (6) a government-entity option instead of a trade licence.
interrogation.d: (1) An offline or on-premise mode: the analysis runs on a department device, or I upload only anonymised or aggregate data, so I don't need cloud approval. (2) A ready-made official data request letter in Arabic, addressed to the other department, explaining what's needed and why, since they work by official correspondence, not links. (3) A bilingual glossary of terms to keep consistency between the report and the department's terminology. (4) A ready 5-slide presentation for leadership plus a one-page summary for the decision memo, in addition to the full report. (5) A record of who approved what and when (an audit trail), attached to the report for internal audit.
